description_en: Queries the sensitive data detection models of a template
name: ListIdentifyModels

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data classification template. You can obtain this value from Items[].Id in the response of the ListTemplates operation. The template must be consistent with the selected sensitivity level and detection models
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板标识，可从 ListTemplates 的 Items[].Id 获取；与所选敏感等级和识别模型保持一致
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: A reserved feature type parameter. This parameter is not used to filter results in the current query. You do not need to specify this parameter for column encryption calls
parameters.help_zh: 保留的功能类型参数。当前查询不使用该参数过滤结果，列加密调用无需传入
parameters.name: feature_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only detection models supported in audit scenarios. If this parameter is set to true, only audit-supported models such as phone number, ID card, and bank card models are returned. You do not need to specify this parameter for column encryption scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 是否限定为审计场景支持的识别模型。true 时筛选手机号、身份证、银行卡等审计支持的模型；列加密场景可不传
parameters.name: filter_audit_model

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

RuleList.description_en: The list of detection models or rules

Id.description_en: The ID of the detection model

Name.description_en: The name of the detection model or rule
